definitions.explanation: An absorbent garment worn by babies or those who are incontinent. Originally from むつき (swaddling cloth) with the honorific prefix お. Both disposable (紙おむつ) and cloth (布おむつ) types exist.

examples.japanese: おむつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ。
examples.english: It's time to change the diaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泣|な}いている→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、おむつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れている→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だろう。
examples.english: The baby is probably crying because the diaper is wet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二歳|にさい}になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧おむつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: My child has turned two, so I'd like to start potty training soon.

notes:
USAGE:
おむつ is the standard everyday word for diapers. The お prefix is not felt as honorific in modern usage — it is simply part of the word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おむつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (change a diaper)
- おむつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (stop using diapers; begin potty training)
- {紙|かみ}おむつ (disposable diaper)
- {布|ぬの}おむつ (cloth diaper)
- おむつ{交換台|こうかんだい} (diaper changing table)

RELATED WORDS:
おむつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ means a child has finished potty training and no longer needs diapers.
